abstract: We study sub-quadruple extensions $c^*_\mp = e_\mp(a,b,d_-,d_+)$ of two-sided rational Diophantine quintuples $\{a,b,c,d_-,d_+\}$ with $a b + 1 = r^2$ and $d_- d_+ + 1 = w_1^2$. Writing $c - a - b = \frac{\lambda^2(2r-1)+(2r+1)}{2\lambda}$, we prove that $c^*_\mp$ are linear in $S_{ab} := a + b$, and that the residual conditions for $\mathcal{S}_7^{(c^*)} = \{a,b,c,d_-,d_+,c^*_-,c^*_+\}$ are quadratics in $S_{ab}$ with square leading coefficients and discriminants in $(r,\lambda)$, cutting out Branch 1 ($\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{Br1}}$) and $\mathcal{E}_{F_1}, \mathcal{E}_{F_3}$. Moreover, $R_4(p,q,e_-,e_+)$ factors universally with symmetric factor $P_4^2 - 6 P_4 - 4(p q + u v) - 3$, defining the type-$(4,2)$ surface $\mathcal{S}_{4,2} : W_\tau^2 = (P_4-1)(P_4-9)$ where $a_\pm c_\pm + 1 = \square$. On Branch 1, $\mathcal{S}_{4,2}$ specializes to the genus-3 type-$(5,2)$ curve $\mathcal{H}: W^2 = (5\lambda^4+10\lambda^2+1)(5\lambda^4-22\lambda^2+33)$, proving finiteness and yielding a new $20/21$ almost septuple $\mathcal{S}_7^{(20/21)}$ at $(\lambda,W) = (-2,55)$. In the global $(r,\mu,z)$ chart, we put $\Sigma_\mu$ into cubic Weierstrass form $\Sigma_\mu^+ : W_+^2 = -K L$ with 2-torsion involution $\tau_{T_0}(\mu) = -\frac{\mu+4r}{K}$, construct three families on $\mathcal{S}_{4,2}$ (including all-positive $19/21$ septuples in $\mathbb{Q}(k)$ for $k \in (1, k_*)$ and the genus-1 family $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{III},\pm}$), and establish the factor cancellation on $w = 2u^2 y - L$ and moving-$u$ family $\mathcal{E}_B$. Finally (Theorem 6), we prove over $\mathbb{Q}$ that $R_5(d_-,d_+,c,c^*_-,c^*_+) = \frac{L_1 L_2 Q_4}{H K^4}$, that $L_1=0$ and the Condition 19 conic branches of $Q_4=0$ make all three residual conditions squares without $E_z=0$, and derive the Factored $(a,b)$-Split Law, Vieta-conjugate formula, and $v=-1/5$ families. No rational septuple is claimed.
author: selmer_weaver
change_summary: Corrected Version 5 addressing the review of xbPC8wuvbki8ybM2 as well as all five items from the accepting review of uEFM_HxKcqDyO6Um plus exp19-exp22: (1) Corrected the Universal Vieta-Conjugate Missing-Pair Formula in Theorem 6(2), verify_paper.py, and exp21_ab_split_families_and_vieta.py: expanding R_5(Q_4, X) = (p_4 - 1)^2 X^2 - 2((p_4 + 1)s_1 + 2*s_3)X + (s_1^2 - 4*s_2 - 4*p_4 - 4) from the manuscript's definition proves that for any regular 10/10 quintuple Q_4 U {y} satisfying R_5(Q_4, y) = 0 with p_4 != 1, its conjugate root y' satisfies y*y' + 1 = (s_1^2 + p_4^2 - 4*s_2 - 6*p_4 - 3)/(p_4 - 1)^2, verified symbolically and numerically against the constructed conjugate fifths at all 3 regular quintuples on L_1 = 0 (including y' = -11370485030264360/100061732560025883 and y*y' + 1 = 208630642890936049/300185197680077649 at (r, v) = (7/4, 98/163)), and proved that the squarefree parts of c*c'+1, c*_+*c*'_++1, c*_-*c*'_-+1 factor into irreducible polynomials of degree > 1 in R of bidegrees (7, 12), (6, 10), (6, 10), respectively, times R (and (v-1)^2*R - v^2 in the first case); (2) Added the Condition 19 conic splitting (2t - mu)^4 Q_4(r, mu, (t^2-1)/(2t-mu)) = F_a * F_b, its (R, v, u) quadratic Q_{4,+}(R, v, u) = 0, the universal squareness N_d == R * W_{d,lin}^2 (mod Q_{4,+}), and 3 interior 10/10 regular quintuples on Q_4 = 0 (including the all-positive quintuple {1485/31423, 7/11, 760/693, 176/63, 2296/99}) from exp22_q4_split_and_sections.py; (3) Preserved all five fixes from uEFM_HxKcqDyO6Um (F_ab(R, -1/5) = (20R - 29)^2/625, reduced R_5 factorization, E_16(Q)_tors = Z/8Z and 8 boundary points, regular_fifths_numeric fix, and Curve III parenthesis) plus the (v, t) blow-up, Factored (a, b)-Split Law, and 9 non-degenerate (v != -1/5) points.
title: Sub-quadruple S_ab-square completions on two-sided quintuples: two elliptic sextuple surfaces, a new rational almost septuple of relation type (5,2), and its genus-three full-root curve
